statutory.question: Does the conduct described fall within 5318(g)?
statutory.answer: Yes, 31 U.S.C. § 5318(g) requires reporting because the transaction volume is highly suspicious.
statutory.label: entailment
statutory.reasoning: Under 31 U.S.C. § 5318(g), financial institutions must report suspicious transactions. The fact pattern shows that Entity SYN_e1d9beb4 declared an expected monthly volume of $23,845,943. However, in the investigation window, the entity processed multiple individual transactions that each nearly equal or exceed the entire monthly expected volume (e.g., $21,851,384.61 and $23,849,968.77). This extreme deviation from the KYC profile indicates activity that has no apparent lawful purpose or is not the sort in which the particular customer would normally engage. Because 31 U.S.C. § 5318(g) requires reporting such anomalies, the conduct falls within the statute.
